sentences.title: Ribbon Eels
sentences.en: …, it looks just like a colorful ribbon waving in the water.

sentences.title: Ribbon Eels

sentences.title: Ribbon Eels

sentences.en: As it gets bigger, its body turns bright blue and, …

sentences.title: Ribbon Eels
sentences.en: When a ribbon eel turns blue, it has become a fully adult male.
sentences.ko: 리본 장어가 파란색으로 바뀌면, 그것은 완전히 다 자란 수컷이 된 것이다.
sentences.target: it has become a fully adult male

sentences.title: Ribbon Eels
sentences.en: So, it is not easy to find yellow ribbon eels in the wild.
sentences.ko: 그래서, 야생에서 노란색 리본 장어를 발견하는 것은 쉽지 않다.
sentences.target: it is not easy to find

sentences.title: Magellan’s Great Discovery
sentences.en: The Pacific Ocean is the deepest and largest of the five major oceans on Earth.
sentences.ko: 태평양은 지구의 오대양 중 가장 깊고 크다.

sentences.title: Magellan’s Great Discovery
sentences.en: The name itself was given by Portuguese navigator Ferdinand Magellan …
sentences.ko: 그 이름 자체는 포르투갈 항해사 Ferdinand Magellan이 지었다.

sentences.title: Magellan’s Great Discovery
sentences.en: He and his crew sailed from Spain in 1519 to find a route …
sentences.ko: 그와 그의 선원들은 항로를 찾기 위해 1519년 스페인에서 출항했다.

sentences.title: Magellan’s Great Discovery
sentences.en: He believed the Spice Islands were very near, but that would prove untrue.
sentences.ko: 그는 향료 제도가 매우 가까이에 있다고 믿었지만, 그것은 사실이 아닌 것으로 판명 났다.

sentences.title: Magellan’s Great Discovery
sentences.en: To this day, we still haven’t explored much of this enormous ocean.
sentences.ko: 오늘날까지, 우리는 여전히 이 거대한 바다를 많이 탐험하지 못했다.

quiz.q: The eel dies about a month ____ it lays eggs. (~한 후에)
____ it turns blue, it becomes a fully adult male. (~할 때)
He believed the islands were near, ____ that proved untrue. (그러나)
Wash your hands ____ you have dinner. (~하기 전에)
Which do you like better, summer (and / or) winter?
The food was cheap (but / or) tasty.
Ribbon eels have long (and / or) flat bodies.
After it will lay eggs, the eel dies.
quiz.a: After it lays eggs, the eel dies.
